global: This shio ramen features a clear, light broth with tender chashu pork, menma, and a naruto fish cake, arranged atop noodles in a patterned bowl. Warm, natural light highlights the meal on a wooden table beside a glass.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and natural texture with subtle knots and variations.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with red geometric rim pattern and colorful floral motifs along its edge.
regions.soup: Shio ramen broth with noodles, pale yellow, translucent, swirling, surface glistening with oil and floating green herbs.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and rounded, slightly curved shape.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: tender, pale brown slices with visible marbling and slightly glistening surface, curled edges, resting in broth.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with fibrous texture and irregular, curved shapes.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: white, soft, round with pink spiral pattern on its surface.
